relations.subject: Zhuan Dao
relations.evidence: In 1906, he assisted Venerable Hsu Yun to deliver the royal Tripitaka Volume to a monastery in Yunnan.

relations.subject: Zhuan Dao
relations.evidence: Poo Thor Jee (普陀寺) was founded in 1911 by Venerable Zhuan Dao at Narcis Street in Tanjong Pagar

relations.subject: Zhuan Dao
relations.object: Kong Meng San Phor Kark See Monastery
relations.evidence: He founded the Phor Kark See Temple in 1920. The temple was built in 1921 on a plot of land donated by Chinese businessman, Tay Woo Seng, and subsequently became known as the Kong Meng San Phor Kark See Monastery

relations.subject: Hong Choon
relations.place: Kong Meng San Phor Kark See Monastery
relations.evidence: Zhuan Dao died in 1943 at Putuo Monastery at the age of 72 and Kong Meng San Phor Kark See Monastery was succeeded by Venerable Hong Choon.
